description.zh: 通过 dbx CLI 直连 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MongoDB、ClickHouse 等数据库。左侧连接管理、中间表浏览器、右侧 SQL 编辑器+结果表格，内置写保护和生产环境安全闸。
description.en: Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse and more via dbx CLI. Connection manager on the left, table browser in the middle, SQL editor + result grid on the right, with built-in write protection and production safety gates.
